title.en: Wheat genetic resources, in the field
title.zh: 走进田间：不丹小麦遗传资源研究

summary.en: Farmer interviews and multi-elevation field trials, connecting local production knowledge with wheat germplasm research.
summary.zh: 开展农户访谈与多海拔田间试验，将当地生产经验、种质历史与小麦遗传资源研究相结合。

body.en: As part of a collaborative wheat genetic resources project, I conducted farmer interviews, helped design and establish multi-elevation field trials, and worked with partner institutions to connect field observations with accession histories and genomic analyses.
body.zh: 在合作开展的小麦遗传资源项目中，我参与农户访谈、试验地点规划、试验布局与材料种植，并与合作机构共同连接田间观察、种质来源记录及基因组分析。

title.en: Hands-on training in wheat DNA extraction
title.zh: 小麦基因组 DNA 提取实践教学

summary.en: Demonstration and supervised laboratory practice, with an emphasis on sample handling and reproducible procedures.
summary.zh: 通过操作示范和实验指导开展小麦 DNA 提取教学，注重样品处理和实验流程的可重复性。

body.en: I taught wheat genomic DNA extraction through demonstrations and supervised practice within the collaborative wheat genetic resources project in Bhutan.
body.zh: 在不丹小麦遗传资源合作项目中，通过示范与现场指导开展小麦基因组 DNA 提取实践教学。

title.zh: 欧洲学术访问与德国 BioHackathon

summary.en: Planned research discussions in Zurich and participation in BioHackathon Germany on image-based wheat phenotyping.
summary.zh: 计划在苏黎世开展研究交流，并参加德国 BioHackathon，围绕小麦图像表型开展合作。

body.en: Planned visits include ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich, followed by BioHackathon Germany in Göttingen (7–11 December). Topics include wheat diversity, adaptation, image-based phenotyping, and wheat spike detection. This activity is planned, not yet completed.
body.zh: 计划访问苏黎世联邦理工学院与苏黎世大学，随后参加哥廷根的德国 BioHackathon（12 月 7–11 日）。交流主题包括小麦多样性、适应性、图像表型与麦穗检测。本活动尚未完成。
